studies.label: SWIFT's blockchain ledger is moving real money
How 16 financial giants are going digital

rule: Reading, source-record and collection clocks stay separate. Record lists and guides are labelled by kind; a linked reading does not prove every component of a multi-owner graphic.
presentation_qualifications: 17 roster banks (Swift, Jul 9, 2026); 8 of them appear in 6 bank-published cases. Swift's Sep 28 statement that 'most of the 17' have transacted implies at least 9 banks, so some transacting banks are not yet named in any source.

Real money has moved in bank-reported controlled transactions, but banks call them 'live pilots' or a 'controlled proof of concept' and Swift calls this an 'initial controlled go-live phase'. No general availability date.

DBS publication-date discrepancy: the official raw HTML and embedded publication field say September 7, 2026; its rendered public dateline shows September 6. The Library retains its saved September 7 label and records both source displays without inferring a timezone or correcting the issuer. Execution on September 5 is a separate clock.
The six count is published bilateral cases/pairings, not a census of individual transactions or recurring volume.
